title: Tdarr Proof Pack diagnostics console
summary: Replace the full Tdarr Matrix operator workflow with a durable fixed Proof Pack under E:\Videos\TdarrMatrix\ProofPack, Diagnostics-only controls, fixed Smoke/Proof pack runs, proof row status history, evidence buttons, and guarded cleanup of the old full matrix.
reason: The full 4,632-path matrix was too large for routine proof runs and had become an operator burden after it had served its purpose. A smaller verified proof corpus keeps real-media coverage while making Diagnostics the single safe control surface.
behavior_before: Home surfaced Tdarr Matrix status, Diagnostics exposed report/smoke/30-file/full-matrix actions, and the full downloaded/cache matrix remained the normal test target.
behavior_after: Home no longer renders Tdarr status. Diagnostics exposes Prepare Proof Pack, Smoke Pack, Proof Pack, Strict Proof Gate, and guarded cleanup/archive/delete actions. The proof table shows planned rows before any run, status, last pass evidence, findings, and keyed evidence buttons. The old full matrix paths were removed only after the Proof Pack verified and full-matrix evidence was archived.
